## Skin refinement
### returns-desktop
Use case: identity-preserve / precise retouch. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is ONLY a natural skin/face reference of the same man, NOT a layout or text reference. Correct Image 1 without redesigning it.
The current edit STILL has a visible polygonal CRACK PATTERN and pale lines over the man's forehead, temples, cheeks, neck and hands. This pattern is an image-generation defect, NOT a facial feature to preserve. Erase and REPAINT ALL EXPOSED SKIN from scratch as a clean natural photographic portrait using the ordinary smooth warm-olive skin in Image 2. Continuous soft skin gradients, tiny realistic pores only, normal relaxed human skin. No mosaic, no geometric lines, no peeling/cracked scales, no scratches, no gray/white patches, no harsh oily specular highlights, no embossed texture. You must actually remove all those artificial patterned marks. Hands must also have ordinary healthy skin.

Do not restore any standalone Protein.tn logo; do not copy anything from Image 2 besides natural human skin.
Also refine the desktop text safe zone: reduce ALL three text lines by another 15% and move the block RIGHT. The ONLY requested correction is the human. Replace the stylized illustrated face, neck and hands with a convincing real photographic person, keeping the same recognizable young Tunisian man, same hairstyle, facial hair, smile, head angle and pose. Use ordinary healthy warm olive skin with subtle real pores, smooth continuous natural tone, soft diffuse studio lighting, normal cheeks, natural eyes and teeth. No comic-book outlines, no painterly highlights, no faceted/shattered/wrinkled/engraved/crazed skin, no white markings, no orange overexposure, no glossy plastic look. The result should look like an actual camera photograph seamlessly composited in this exact banner. Do not change any letter, product, money, clothing, layout, background or add any logo.
